lead.event: US sets an 18% tariff on Indonesian goods
lead.headline: US sets 18% tariff on Indonesian goods
lead.blurb: The US announced the rate under its Section 301 excess-capacity scheme, and Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto said it is final. Indonesia secured zero-tariff exemptions for 2,273 commodities, including crude palm oil, rubber, coffee and cocoa, after completing negotiations on commodity rates of 0%, 10% and 18%. Airlangga said the 18% rate is below the initial 25% threat. The government can continue negotiations until 5 January 2027, with a public hearing scheduled for 25 January 2027.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: EMAS shareholders approve a private placement of 1.47 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: EMAS shareholders approve 1.47 billion-share private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Merdeka Gold’s new shares will equal 10% of placed capital and have a nominal value of Rp150 each. At its 26 November extraordinary meeting, the plan won about 58.14% of votes, or 2.33 billion voting rights, with proceeds allocated to working capital (25%), business development (50%) and refinancing or repayment of obligations (25%).

earnings_guidance.event: BRIS outlines its 2027 financing growth outlook
earnings_guidance.headline: BRIS projects double-digit financing growth in 2027
earnings_guidance.blurb: President Director Anggoro Eko Cahyo expects industry liquidity to remain tight through 2027, citing the government’s plan to withdraw excess budget balance funds and a BI rate expected to stay around 6%. He says prudent, selective financing will be key to keeping non-performing financing at safe levels.

earnings_guidance.event: BUMI reports strong Q3 2026 results as shares rebound
earnings_guidance.headline: BUMI reports strong Q3 results as shares rebound 18.49%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bumi posted Q3 net profit of US$89.6 million, up 158.3% quarter on quarter and tenfold year on year, largely on improved performance at KPC. Foreign investors were net buyers of Rp32.87 billion during the week of 23-27 November, following net selling of Rp98.38 billion the prior week.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

earnings_guidance.headline: UBS upgrades BRMS, citing a 6x 2028 projected PER
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bumi Resources Minerals rose 16.55% over 23-27 November, reversing the prior week’s 20.11% decline, when foreign investors net sold Rp156.21 billion. UBS said that selling reflected a potential MSCI Indonesia index downgrade rather than fundamental deterioration, citing production growth prospects backed by adequate gold reserves at BRMS and Merdeka Gold Resources.

earnings_guidance.event: KRAS reports a 246% increase in nine-month net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: KRAS reports 246% increase in nine-month net profit to US$83.1 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Krakatau Steel's net profit was US$4.6 million in Q1 and US$6.3 million through Q2 2026. Steel sales volume rose 18% to 877,700 tons and revenue increased 30% to US$919.8 million. Its corporate secretary attributed growth to the transformation strategy and stronger operational, commercial and financial performance.
